chunks: Whoever suppresses anger, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will reward him.

key_terms.عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: the honorific meaning Mighty and Majestic
key_terms.يَكْظِمِ الْغَيْظَ: to restrain and hold back anger

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for suppressing anger in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the virtue of restraining anger and promises divine reward for doing so. It highlights self-control as a praiseworthy ethical quality before Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.
